acceptance: gate:quick-1 Port SpeedyWatch's Cloudflare AI provider to FrankenKey. Contract (proven at SpeedyWatch v0.53+/v0.61, file app/src/main/java/com/speedywatch/app/AiEndpoint.java + SpeedyWatchSettings.java): POST https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{accountId}/ai/v1/chat/completions — OpenAI-shaped request/response; static @cf/* model catalog (default @cf/meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct-fp8-fast); account ID (non-secret, in prefs) + API token (Keystore AES-GCM) as a selectable provider alongside OpenRouter (Cloudflare = default). Apply to: (1) AI Writing model setting — dropdown picker fed by the static CF catalog, replacing the empty EditText modal; (2) Fix grammar — AUTOMATIC real-time corrections as the user types (per user: NOT a button — continuous in typing flow); (3) Reader summaries/chat/quiz — same provider path. Credential storage pattern identical to SpeedyWatch (Keystore-encrypted token, plain account ID). User's creds exist and are verified working (account 0ca80ee3..., cfat token — do NOT hardcode them; read from settings at runtime). The empty 'AI writing model' modal currently shows nothing — fix the settings surface to a functioning model picker.
